editorial: We did much of our leisure travel in June and July, and for this exact coast-to-coast itinerary summer is the easiest answer.

seasons.title: June to August
editorial: Long days make national parks and road trips easier, Niagara operates in its full tourist mode and you do not have to build the entire route around snow.
The downside is peak crowds, especially in Yosemite and other headline parks.

seasons.title: September & October
editorial: These can be excellent alternatives if you're willing to layer up as you move east. Crowds ease and many destinations remain accessible.

seasons.title: November to March
editorial: Don't be seduced by a cheap airfare into assuming the same itinerary works year-round. Large parts of the country have serious winter weather, short daylight hours and seasonal closures or limited access.
Los Angeles may be delightful while New York freezes. America is large enough for both statements to be true simultaneously.
